p1.quote: "I show up to the lesson without a clear idea of what I'm teaching today."
p1.text: Improvising is fine, but always repeating the same thing isn't. Your students notice.

p2.quote: "I always end up using the same 10 drills."
p2.text: It's not a lack of ideas, it's a lack of time to look for them. Ten Planner does it for you.

p3.quote: "I spend more time planning than coaching."
p3.text: A well-planned session shouldn't take you more than 2 minutes. Seriously.

s1.title: Think the lesson through
s1.text: You have the judgment. Decide whether to explore the library, build your lesson from scratch or bring back a previous session that already worked.

s2.title: Build or adjust
s2.text: Pick drills, put them in order, mix in your favorites or tweak the proposal. You always have full control of the session.

s3.title: Teach and review
s3.text: Take attendance, run the session and record how it went. Everything is saved in your history.

c1.title: Browse and choose
c1.text: Use the explorer: single drills or complete ready-made lessons, all tagged by level, duration, goal and category.

c2.title: Build from scratch
c2.text: Design the lesson drill by drill using the Ten Planner library, your own drills, or a mix of both.

c3.title: Reuse a previous lesson
c3.text: Bring it back from your history or favorites, adjust what you need and teach it again. What already works doesn't need reinventing.

f1.title: Content explorer

f5.title: Attendance
f5.text: Record attendance in seconds. Full history of each student by lesson.

f6.title: My space
f6.text: Your calendar, your groups, your venues, your drills and the lessons you created. All organized in one place.

a1.text: Progress reports for each student, ready to hand to their families.

a2.title: Coach follow-up
a2.text: See the lessons taught and the attendance of each coach at a glance.

a3.text: Group notices and direct messages, so families are always up to date.

terms.el_sistema_elige_el_modelo_segun_la_comp: The system picks the model based on complexity
terms.pega_o_escribe_aqui_uno_o_varios_ejercic: Paste or write one or more drills here: name, how it's done, duration, equipment, variations…
terms.pega_o_escribe_aqui_una_o_varias_clases_: Paste or write one or more lessons here: goals, warm-up, main part, cool-down, duration…
terms.biblioteca_de_ejercicios_de_tenis_con_du: Tennis drill library with duration, level by ball color and tags
terms.ficha_de_un_ejercicio_con_su_animacion_e: A drill sheet with its on-court animation
terms.filtros_de_ejercicios_por_nivel_aspecto_: Drill filters by level, aspect, phase and game situation
terms.estadisticas_de_entrenamiento_tiempo_jug: Training statistics: time played, most-done drill and most-worked stroke
terms.arriba_del_todo_puedes_cambiar_entre_ten: At the very top you can switch between tennis, padel and pickleball. Each sport has its own library, sessions and calendar.
terms.en_ejercicios_y_clases_encontraras_conte: In Drills and Lessons you will find content that is already available (from Ten Planner, from your club or your own). You can create your own and mark favorites to find them quickly.
terms.en_alumnos_registra_sus_fichas_si_entren: In Students, register their profiles. If you coach several at once, create a Group so you don't repeat the process in every session.
terms.desde_sesiones_nueva_sesion_arma_la_sesi: From Sessions → New session, build the session step by step, from a lesson in your library, or with quick creation. The name follows the code YYMMDD_Group (e.g. 260930_Falcons).
terms.si_una_sesion_se_repite_cada_semana_marc: If a session repeats every week, mark it as recurring and choose until which date of the season you want it generated.
terms.las_sesiones_que_mas_repites_puedes_guar: The sessions you repeat the most can be saved in Lists, inside the Sessions menu, so you don't have to build them from scratch again.
terms.consulta_el_calendario_y_tus_lugares: Check the Calendar and your Places
terms.el_calendario_te_muestra_la_semana_de_un: The Calendar shows you the week at a glance. In Places, save the courts or facilities where you usually coach.
terms.es_un_chat_aparte_de_la_planificacion_no: It is a separate chat from normal planning: use it when you want help writing or solving specific questions, not to replace the three ways of creating sessions.
terms.no_es_un_marketplace_tu_club_aporta_ejer: It is not a marketplace: your club contributes validated drills and lessons to the public library for free and in return gets brand visibility. Ten Planner does not handle payments between club and platform.
terms.desde_mi_club_puedes_dar_de_alta_tu_club: From My club you can register your club and invite by email the coaches who are part of it.
terms.cuando_un_monitor_acepta_la_invitacion_e: When a coach accepts the invitation, the club has shared access to their sessions, students, groups and calendar for that sport — each coach keeps their own individual dashboard.
terms.lo_que_aporteis_a_la_biblioteca_se_etiqu: What you contribute to the library is tagged with the club's authorship, so it is clear where each drill or lesson comes from.
terms.al_entrar_eliges_tu_deporte_activo_tenis: When you log in you choose your active sport (tennis, padel or pickleball) at the top of the app. You can change it whenever you want; each sport has its own library, sessions and calendar, although they share the same type of content.
terms.el_dashboard_inicio_te_resume_tus_proxim: The Dashboard (Home) summarizes your upcoming sessions and shortcuts to what you use most.
terms.ejercicios_tiene_cuatro_vistas_bibliotec: Drills has four views: Library (everything available — yours, Ten Planner's or your club's), My drills (only yours), Favorites and Drafts. From there you also create a new drill.
terms.clases_sigue_la_misma_estructura_bibliot: Lessons follows the same structure: Library, My lessons, Lists (lessons saved to reuse) and Drafts. A lesson groups several drills already organized in blocks.
terms.puedes_buscar_y_filtrar_por_nivel_golpe_: You can search and filter by level, stroke, phase, duration and goal to find what you need quickly.
terms.en_alumnos_das_de_alta_la_ficha_de_cada_: In Students you register each one's profile: attendance, notes and progress are saved so the next session starts with context.
terms.en_grupos_agrupas_a_los_alumnos_que_entr: In Groups you gather the students who train together so you can assign them to a session at once, instead of selecting them one by one every time.
terms.los_grupos_son_editables_despues_de_crea: Groups can be edited after they are created: you can add or remove students when the composition changes.
terms.desde_cero_el_asistente_de_nueva_sesion_: From scratch: the new session wizard has 2 steps — Setup (title, date and time, duration, goal/equipment/notes, which students or group it is for, and whether it repeats) and Drills (you build the plan by dragging drills from your library or adding free text, organized by blocks and phases: warm-up, technique, tactics, fitness, stations or rest).
terms.a_partir_de_una_clase_eliges_una_clase_y: From a lesson: you choose a ready-made lesson from your library as a starting point and adjust it for that day and that group.
terms.sesion_rapida_crea_una_sesion_minima_con: Quick session: creates a minimal session with only the title, to complete calmly later.
terms.el_nombre_puede_generarse_solo_con_el_co: The name can be generated automatically with the date + group code (YYMMDD_Group, e.g. 260930_Falcons) or written by hand; as soon as you edit it manually, it stops updating automatically.
terms.dentro_del_paso_de_configuracion_puedes_: Inside the Setup step you can enable repetition: you choose the days of the week it repeats and until when — a specific date or a number of weeks.
terms.por_defecto_el_fin_de_curso_sugerido_es_: By default, the suggested end of season is June 30. All the sessions are generated at once (up to 120 at a time).
terms.modo_ejecutar_abre_la_sesion_en_pista_co: Run mode: opens the session on court with a stopwatch (or countdown) that guides you block by block and phase by phase.
terms.en_sesiones_puedes_filtrar_entre_proxima: In Sessions you can filter between Upcoming, Past, Cancelled and Drafts.
terms.listas_te_deja_guardar_sesiones_como_pla: Lists let you save sessions as templates to repeat them without building them again.
terms.puedes_cancelar_una_sesion_sin_eliminarl: You can cancel a session without deleting it, so there is a record that it was not held.
terms.el_calendario_te_muestra_todas_tus_sesio: The Calendar shows all your scheduled sessions at a glance.
terms.en_lugares_guardas_las_pistas_o_instalac: In Places you save the courts or facilities where you usually coach; each place shows how many sessions and minutes you have given there.
terms.guarda_enlaces_documentos_e_imagenes_que: Save links, documents and images that help you in your work as a coach, organized in All and Favorites.
terms.es_un_chat_aparte_del_flujo_normal_de_pl: It is a separate chat from the normal planning flow — it does not replace the three ways of creating a session, but is a one-off support: ask it for help writing something, solving a question or giving you ideas.
terms.si_formas_parte_de_un_club_en_mi_club_ve: If you are part of a club, in My club you see which one you belong to. If you created it, from there you manage the invitations to other coaches.
terms.en_perfil_editas_tus_datos_personales_y_: In Profile you edit your personal details and your photo.
terms.no_es_un_marketplace_el_club_aporta_ejer: It is not a marketplace: the club contributes validated drills and lessons to the public library for free.
terms.a_cambio_obtiene_visibilidad_de_marca_en: In return it gets brand visibility (a link or mention), not a payment managed by Ten Planner — the platform does not intermediate payments between the club and anyone else.
terms.desde_mi_club_das_de_alta_tu_club_si_tod: From My club you register your club if you do not belong to one yet.
terms.una_vez_creado_invitas_por_email_a_los_m: Once created, you invite by email the coaches who are part of it.
terms.compartir_sin_perder_el_panel_individual: Share without losing the individual dashboard
terms.cuando_un_monitor_acepta_la_invitacion_e: When a coach accepts the invitation, the club gets shared access to their sessions, students, groups and calendar for that sport.
terms.cada_monitor_conserva_su_propio_panel_in: Each coach keeps their own individual dashboard — nobody loses their personal workspace by being part of the club.
terms.lo_que_aporteis_a_la_biblioteca_publica_: What you contribute to the public library is tagged with the club's authorship, so it is identified where each drill or lesson comes from.
terms.si_el_club_trabaja_varios_deportes_tenis: If the club works with several sports (tennis, padel, pickleball), each one is managed with its own content and calendar within the same club.
terms.para_aparecer_en_la_landing_publica_o_pe: To appear on the public landing page or customize the brand, talk to the Ten Planner administration team.

terms.espejo_por_parejas_uno_guia_y_el_otro_co: Mirror in pairs: one leads and the other copies
